name: Chicago Deep Dish
summary: Laminated cornmeal crust, built upside down.

steps.text: Mix a stiff dough with the cornmeal. Bulk one hour.
Roll flat, spread with soft butter, roll up and coil. Chill.
Press the coiled dough up the sides of a deep pan.
Layer cheese first, then filling, then sauce on top.

bake.notes: Long, moderate bake. The crust must cook through under all that weight.

notes: The butter lamination is what separates it from bread in a pan.
